description: Add an email address or a whole domain to the suppression list, e.g. after an unsubscribe, an objection (GDPR Art. 21), an erasure request (Art. 17) or an access request (Art. 15).

domain.description: Whole domain to block, e.g. example.com (give email or domain)

email.description: Email address to block (give email or domain)

gdprAccess.description: Art. 15 access request received (starts a 1-month answer deadline)

reason.description: unsubscribe | objection (Art. 21) | erasure (Art. 17) | access (Art. 15) | complaint | bounce | manual

receivedAt.description: ISO 8601 time the request was received (default now)

name: add_suppression
title: Add to suppression list
